letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow you bring to my life, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. From the glittering skyline to the fragrant spice markets, my heart follows you wherever we are. I cherish our laughter, our quiet evenings, and the way you call me “cutie” with that mischievous sparkle in your eyes. Today feels like a gentle reminder that love, like the season, blooms anew—just as it did on that beautiful February day.
poem:
In desert dunes or river’s flow,  
Your love’s the compass I always know.  
With every laugh, with every kiss,  
My world is brighter, thanks to you, my bliss.
